description:
Job Role: HR Generalist 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced and proactive HR Generalist to manage day-to-day HR operations and support employees across the employee lifecycle. The role will involve a combination of Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Engagement, Grievance Handling, Payroll Coordination, and Compliance.

Handle onboarding and joining formalities for new employees and ensure a smooth induction process. Manage day-to-day HR operations including employee records, documentation, attendance, leave, and HRMS updates. Conduct regular employee interactions and provide HR support to employees and managers. Maintain accurate HR reports, MIS, and other relevant employee data. Support performance management, employee confirmation, transfers, and other employee lifecycle processes. Ensure adherence to company policies and statutory requirements. Undertake travel to business locations/sites whenever and wherever required as part of the role.

title: HR Manager
description:
Job Description HR Manager Designation: HR Manager
 Department: Human Resources
 Experience: 812 Years
 Location: Ahmedabad
 Industry: Pharmaceutical / Healthcare 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and people-oriented HR Manager to lead and manage key HR functions including employee lifecycle management, onboarding, compliance, payroll, performance management, employee engagement, talent management, grievance handling, and separation processes. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of HR policies, labour laws, statutory compliance, employee relations, and performance management, along with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Onboarding & Induction Design and implement structured onboarding and induction programs for new employees. Coordinate offer formalities, joining documentation, background verification, and employee records. Ensure cross-functional coordination with IT, Administration, Finance, and other departments for Day 1 readiness. Conduct employee orientation covering company policies, culture, processes, and role expectations. Monitor onboarding effectiveness and support faster time-to-productivity for new hires. 2. HR Compliance & Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops & Establishments, and other applicable regulations . Review and update HR policies in accordance with changes in legislation and organisational requirements. Coordinate statutory audits, inspections, filings, and documentation. Maintain accurate employee records and statutory documentation. Coordinate with legal advisors and labour-law consultants on compliance-related matters. 3. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Oversee accurate and timely monthly payroll processing. Manage compensation structures, employee benefits, reimbursements, and allowances. Coordinate salary revisions and maintain compensation records. Support salary benchmarking and compensation analysis against relevant market standards. Ensure proper statutory deductions, payroll compliance, and payroll audits. Resolve employee queries related to salary, deductions, benefits, and reimbursements. 4. Performance Management & Appraisals Develop and administer the organization's performance management process. Coordinate KRA/KPI setting, goal setting, mid-year reviews, and annual performance appraisals . Facilitate performance discussions between employees and managers. Support managers in providing structured and constructive feedback. Identify performance gaps and coordinate Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs). Support recognition and reward initiatives for high-performing employees. 5. Employee Reviews & Increment Management Manage annual and periodic performance review cycles. Coordinate increment and promotion recommendations with functional and departmental heads. Ensure consistency and proper documentation of performance ratings and salary revisions. Maintain records of employee performance, increments, promotions, and related decisions. 6. Employee Separations & Full & Final Settlement Manage the complete employee separation process, including resignation acceptance, notice-period tracking, and exit formalities. Coordinate knowledge transfer and proper handover processes. Ensure timely processing of Full & Final Settlement (F&F) . Coordinate issuance of relieving letters, experience certificates, and other separation documents. Manage involuntary separations in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements. 7. Exit Interviews & Attrition Analysis Conduct structured exit interviews with separating employees. Capture and analyse reasons for employee attrition. Identify recurring trends, retention risks, and areas requiring management intervention. Share actionable insights and recommendations with senior management. Maintain confidentiality and objectivity while handling exit feedback. 8. Talent Management & Learning & Development Support succession planning and internal talent mapping. Identify critical roles and potential internal talent. Conduct skill-gap analysis and coordinate training and development initiatives. Support employee career development and internal mobility programs. Assist in developing employee engagement and retention initiatives. 9. Employee Grievance & Employee Relations Establish effective channels for employee grievance redressal. Address employee concerns and complaints fairly, professionally, and within defined timelines. Conduct appropriate investigations while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure resolutions are aligned with company policies and applicable laws. Escalate sensitive matters, including harassment, ethical concerns, and serious employee-relations issues, through the appropriate channels. Track grievance trends and recommend corrective actions to improve employee relations. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management . Good understanding of labour laws and statutory compliance . Strong payroll and compensation management knowledge. Experience in performance management, KRA/KPI frameworks, and appraisal processes. Strong employee relations and grievance-handling skills. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee matters. Strong stakeholder-management and team-management skills. Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS/HRIS platforms . Preferred Candidate Profile MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification. 8–12 years of relevant experience in HR, preferably in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing, or related industry . Hands-on experience managing end-to-end HR operations. Strong exposure to statutory compliance, payroll, employee relations, performance management, and HR policies. Experience in managing HR processes independently and working closely with senior management.

Key Skills: Corporate HR,HR Generalist Activities,Performance Management System,HR Policy Formulation,Strategic HR,Employee Engagement,Employee Retention,HR Policies

title: Senior HR Executive (Operations & Keka HRMS Specialist)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a dynamic and highly experienced Senior HR Executive to take complete ownership of our core HR operations. This role is built for a true HR technologist and operations expert who possesses a flawless, inside-out understanding of Keka HRMS. 
 As a Senior HR Executive, you will act as the backbone of our employee lifecycle, managing everything from seamless onboarding to graceful exits. You will ensure our payroll runs without a hitch, our workplace culture remains vibrant, and our organization remains 100% compliant with Indian labor laws and IT industry standards. If you are a process-driven HR professional who knows how to leverage technology to automate and streamline HR functions, we want you on our team.
 Who You Are Personality & Interpersonal: You have a chirpy and bubbly personality that naturally connects with people. Highly emotionally intelligent, you can easily read the mood of the workforce and are deeply passionate about fostering a positive work environment. Drive & Ownership: You are driven, ambitious, and actively looking to transform into an HR Manager role. You take full ownership of the HR function, working closely with leadership to proactively identify improvement areas and close those gaps. Functional Expertise: You possess strong operational HR skills, are deeply knowledgeable about payroll and statutory compliance, and are skilled in compensation planning. Crucially, you have a strong willingness to grow from operational tasks into strategic HR leadership. Systems & Efficiency Mindset: You are comfortable leveraging AI to drive efficiency and productivity. You focus heavily on building resilient systems and processes that teams can learn from, effectively reducing the organization's dependency on any single individual. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Keka HRMS Mastery & Data Insights Act as the absolute Subject Matter Expert (SME) and primary administrator for our Keka HRMS platform. Flawlessly configure, update, and manage all Keka modules, including Leave & Attendance, Payroll, Performance Management, and Expense flows. Create and automate backend workflows and customized reports. Prepare weekly and monthly HR reports that surface workforce-related challenges in alignment with business priorities. Troubleshoot system glitches, adapt the platform to evolving company policies, and train staff on using the portal effectively. 
 2. End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management Onboarding: Handle pre-joining and onboarding formalities. Generate offer letters, conduct thorough background verifications (BGV), set up IT assets, and execute engaging induction programs. Offboarding/Exits: Manage seamless exit formalities, conduct empathetic exit interviews, manage departmental clearances, and ensure accurate Full & Final (FnF) settlements. 
 3. Payroll, Compensation & Budgeting Manage end-to-end pre-payroll activities, ensuring 100% accuracy in leave, attendance, and loss of pay (LOP) data within Keka. Oversee salary structuring, tax declarations, and take charge of compensation planning. Propose and manage the overall HR budget, working closely with the founders to allocate sufficient budget for high-impact employee welfare and engagement activities. Coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team to process monthly payroll on time, resolving grievances promptly. 
 4. Performance Management & Team Leadership Oversee and manage a 360 performance appraisal system that drives high performance and continuous growth across the company. Mentor junior HR team members , conducting regular 1:1s and empowering the team to achieve more. Promote a results-driven culture while actively maintaining high team morale. 
 5. Employee Experience & Relations Interact with remote and in-office employees, maintaining a healthy balance and cohesive culture between the remote and in-person experience. Design and execute high-impact employee engagement initiatives, team-building activities, and workplace wellness programs tailored to IT professionals. Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances, resolving conflicts professionally, empathetically, and in strict adherence to company policies. 
 6. Statutory Compliance & IT Industry Standards Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of Indian labor laws applicable to the IT sector (e.g., Shops and Establishments Act, Maternity Benefit Act, POSH). Ensure strict compliance and timely remittance of all statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, and Gratuity). Stay updated on changing labor regulations and minimum wage revisions to advise management on risk mitigation. 
 7. Core HR Administration Draft, update, and enforce HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs), ensuring these processes are well-documented for the team. Maintain highly confidential employee records, organizational charts, and digital files securely.

title: HR Executive
description:
POSITION DETAILS Position: HR Executive Department: Human Resources Location: Ahmedabad Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: Work From Office Experience: 13 Years Reporting To: HR Manager 
 ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented HR Executive to join our Human Resources team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting end-to-end recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, onboarding, employee records, and day-to-day HR activities .The candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, a positive attitude, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple HR activities simultaneously in a fast-paced IT environment. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. RECRUITMENT & TALENT ACQUISITION Manage end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical positions. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels . Screen resumes based on job requirements and organizational needs. Conduct initial HR screening calls and candidate assessments . Coordinate technical, managerial, and HR interviews with candidates and hiring managers. Maintain regular communication and follow-ups with candidates throughout the hiring process. Coordinate offer discussions, documentation, and joining formalities. Follow up with selected candidates to ensure successful joining. Maintain recruitment trackers, ATS, candidate databases, and hiring reports. Prepare regular recruitment status and hiring reports. Build and maintain a healthy candidate pipeline for current and future requirements. Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. 2. HR OPERATIONS Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR documentation . Manage employee onboarding and exit formalities. Coordinate employee attendance and leave-related activities. Maintain and update employee information in Keka HRMS . Handle day-to-day employee queries and provide appropriate HR support. Support employee confirmation and appraisal processes. Maintain HR policies, processes, forms, and related documentation. Ensure proper documentation and record-keeping for HR activities. Support the HR Manager in implementing and improving HR processes. Coordinate with employees and internal departments for various HR requirements. Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR-related documents. 3. ONBOARDING & EXIT MANAGEMENT Coordinate the complete employee onboarding process. Ensure timely completion of joining documentation and required formalities. Coordinate with IT/Admin teams for system, workstation, access, and other joining requirements. Conduct or coordinate HR induction for new employees. Ensure new employees are introduced to company policies, processes, and culture. Coordinate employee exit formalities, documentation, and clearance processes. Conduct exit discussions/interviews where required. Maintain accurate onboarding and exit records. 4. EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT & CULTURE Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities throughout the year. Organize Fun Fridays, team-building activities, games, celebrations, and employee activities . Plan and coordinate Employee of the Month (EOM) activities and recognition programs. Coordinate employee birthday celebrations and special occasions. Plan and decorate the office for festivals and celebrations. Coordinate annual events, picnics, outings, celebrations, and other employee programs. Collect employee feedback and identify opportunities to improve employee experience. Suggest and implement new engagement initiatives based on employee feedback. Work closely with employees to promote a positive and collaborative workplace culture. 5. EVENT & VENDOR COORDINATION Coordinate with external vendors for HR and employee engagement activities. Manage vendors for food, gifts, decorations, event arrangements, venues, and other requirements . Obtain quotations and coordinate with vendors as required. Ensure events and activities are executed smoothly and within approved budgets. Coordinate logistics and arrangements for company events and celebrations. Maintain records of vendors, quotations, bills, and event-related expenses. 6. HR REPORTING & DOCUMENTATION Maintain accurate HR trackers and reports. Prepare recruitment and employee-related reports as required. Maintain employee databases and HR documentation. Track recruitment status, joining status, attrition, attendance, and other HR metrics. Ensure timely updating of HRMS and internal HR records. Support the HR Manager with HR data and reports for management review. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field . 1-3 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in an IT/software organization . Good understanding of recruitment and HR operations. Experience in technical recruitment will be an added advantage. Hands-on experience with recruitment portals such as Naukri and LinkedIn . Experience working with HRMS/ATS systems; knowledge of Keka is preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Good organizational and time-management abilities. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Proactive, approachable, and positive attitude. Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and company information. 
 KEY COMPETENCIES Recruitment & Talent Acquisition HR Operations Employee Relations Employee Engagement Communication Skills Stakeholder Coordination Vendor Management Event Management Problem Solving Time Management Documentation & Reporting Team Collaboration 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who is energetic, organized, people-oriented, and willing to take ownership of HR activities. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently while also collaborating with employees, managers, vendors, and other departments.The HR Executive will play an important role in supporting both business hiring requirements and employee experience while ensuring smooth execution of day-to-day HR processes.

On behalf of ASL, iEmpower Leaders is hiring an Accounts Payable & Payment Process Executive to be based in Ahmedabad, India. title: Assistant Manager HR Operations & Administration
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Assistant Manager HR Operations & Administration to manage and oversee key HR operational processes along with administrative activities across the organization. 
 The role will be responsible for ensuring smooth execution of Payroll, HRIS/HRMS management, employee lifecycle processes, HR data management, compliance support , and administrative/vendor management activities . 
 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in HR Operations and Administration, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, employees, management, and external vendors. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. HR Operations Payroll Management Manage and coordinate the complete monthly payroll process in collaboration with Finance and relevant stakeholders. Ensure accurate collection and validation of attendance, leave, salary revisions, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, and other payroll-related inputs. Coordinate with payroll vendors, Finance, and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate salary processing. Address employee queries related to salary, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll. Ensure payroll records and documentation are maintained accurately and confidentially. Support statutory and compliance-related payroll requirements. 
 HRIS & HRMS Management Manage and maintain employee data on the organization's HRIS/HRMS platform . Ensure accurate employee information, including onboarding details, employee records, reporting structures, attendance, leave, and other HR data. Coordinate with HRMS/HRIS vendors for system-related issues, enhancements, and process improvements. Monitor data accuracy and ensure regular audits of HRMS records. Support implementation of new HR modules, processes, and automation initiatives. Generate HR reports and dashboards from the HRMS as required by management. Train and support employees and managers in using HRMS systems and processes. 
 Employee Lifecycle Management Oversee HR operational activities across the employee lifecycle, including: Joining and onboarding documentation Employee data management Confirmation processes Transfers and internal movements Salary revisions and promotions Employee exits and separation documentation Ensure all employee records and HR documentation are updated accurately and maintained as per company policies. 
 HR Operations & Process Improvement Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR operational processes and SOPs. Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency. Ensure timely completion of HR operational activities and adherence to defined timelines. Support HR audits and provide necessary documentation and reports. Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of employee information. 
 2. Administration & Vendor Management Administrative Operations Oversee day-to-day administrative operations to ensure smooth functioning of the office. Coordinate with internal teams to address administrative requirements and operational needs. Support office infrastructure, facilities, and workplace management activities. Ensure administrative processes are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with company policies. 
 Vendor Management Act as the primary point of contact for vendors related to administrative and facility requirements. Coordinate with vendors for services including office facilities, housekeeping, security, transport, maintenance, supplies, and other administrative requirements. Monitor vendor performance and ensure services are delivered as per agreed standards. Coordinate vendor contracts, renewals, invoices, and payment-related documentation. Work closely with Finance and internal stakeholders for timely processing of vendor payments. Negotiate and manage vendor relationships to ensure quality service and cost efficiency. Maintain proper records of vendor agreements, invoices, and service-related documentation. 
 Facilities & Office Management Ensure smooth functioning of office facilities and infrastructure. Coordinate maintenance and repair requirements with relevant vendors.
